items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: And then John Hammond called me. And they were very fond of Wes.

ctx.x: And I remember a thing that happened, and that's when I was telling Buddy about it, because when it happened, it struck me kind of funny. Not funny; it just struck me. I got a call from a...I received a letter. First I received a letter of condolence from -- what's his name, from Columbia Records? --

John Hammond. And then John Hammond called me. And they were very fond of Wes. Oh, everybody was. Even though that wasn't his label he was recording with, or anything. He was very fond of Wes. So he was saying, while he understood where everything was at musically, with us and Wes, and blah-blah-blah, but he was wondering was it possible if Buddy and I could hook up with George Benson and sort of continue...George was so close, was closer to Wes's thing. Because what Wes had created was like a factory,…
